title: private-installer: HA/DR automation (multi-AZ terraform, helm updates, restore drills & runbooks-as-code)
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds automated HA/DR tooling for Private Installer: multi-AZ Terraform module updates, Helm chart changes for pod anti-affinity and PDBs, a restore-drill CLI and GH Actions workflow, runbooks-as-code for scheduled drills and failover procedures. Non-breaking; opt-in via installer flags.
commits: terraform: add multi-az support and az-aware subnet module (ENG-2345)
helm: topologySpread & anti-affinity + configurable PDBs for control-plane and data-plane
ops: add runbooks-as-code for ha/dr drills and failover runbook templates
tools: restore-drill CLI + integration test harness
ci: workflow to run restore drills against staging cluster (scheduled)
docs: private-installer HA/DR upgrade and rollback guide
description:
Motivation: Customers using Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments require automated, repeatable HA and disaster recovery (DR) procedures that are testable and safe to run in staging and can be executed during upgrades. This PR bundles infra, helm, tooling, and runbooks-as-code to make scheduled restore drills and failover rehearsals first-class and automatable.

Summary of changes: adds multi-AZ aware Terraform changes (subnet allocation, AZ tagging, cross-AZ load-balancer annotations), Helm chart updates to enforce pod anti-affinity, topologySpreadConstraints, and configurable PodDisruptionBudgets for control-plane and data-plane components, a restore-drill CLI that orchestrates snapshot/restore flows and verifies post-restore health, a GitHub Actions workflow to run drills on a staging cluster on a schedule, runbooks-as-code (markdown + checklists) for run teams, and small installer flags to opt clusters into automated drills and safe rollback windows.

Commits: see commit list for high level messages. Commits are squashed on merge; intermediate commits include quick fixes to variable naming and additional test hooks.

Files changed (high level): terraform modules updated to be az-aware and to optionally create cross-az LB targets; helm templates updated to add topologySpreadConstraints and explicit anti-affinity rules for critical StatefulSets; a new pdb.yaml template is added and enabled by default for production profiles; installer gains an --ha-dr-enabled boolean and --drill-cron schedule flag; tools/restore-drill contains the drill orchestration CLI plus a small shell harness used by CI; ops/runbooks contains the runbooks-as-code for restore drills, failover playbook and a checklist for post-restore verification; CI workflow schedules runs and posts a summary comment.

Testing and CI: Added an integration test that runs the restore workflow against a trimmed staging cluster (tests/integration/ha_dr_restore_test.sh). CI added a new workflow .github/workflows/ha-dr-drill.yml that is protected and only runs on the staging environment; for PRs it runs unit tests and a dry-run of the drill CLI with mocked snapshot endpoints. A flaky network test caused an initial failure in CI on 2026-02-18; I re-ran the job and it passed. Final merge proceeded after green CI.

Review thread and changes requested: Miguel requested explicit rollback steps in the runbook and a short-circuit flag for emergency aborts in the restore-drill CLI. Priya asked for stronger invariants around PDBs (make them opt-in per profile) and for an upgrade/rollback test matrix entry. Review conversation excerpts: "Miguel Alvarez: please add emergency abort + documented rollback path; drills must be interruptible." "Asha Patel: added --abort-window flag and included rollback checklist in ops/runbooks/ha-dr/failover-playbook.md. see commit 3f9b." "Priya Nair: prefer PDBs to be opt-in for dev profiles; LGTM once CI is green." 

Approvals: After addressing comments, Miguel and Priya approved. Ethan added a final pass for Terraform variable naming and signed off. CI status: pass (unit tests, lints, integration dry-runs, scheduled workflow validation).

Merge outcome: squash-merged into main on 2026-02-24 by Asha Patel. Merge note: non-breaking opt-in changes; default production profile enables HA/DR features but installer flags allow teams to opt-out for older clusters.

Operational impact and followups: Ops runbooks are now code-reviewed and stored in repo under ops/runbooks/ha-dr; SRE will schedule the first automated restore drill for staging on 2026-03-03. Follow-up items tracked in ENG-2345: add more post-restore data validation checks and extend the GH Actions workflow to run canary traffic verification.

Notes for reviewers of future PRs touching these areas: 1) keep runbooks in ops/runbooks/ha-dr as markdown with checklists; 2) any change to helm pdb/default affinity needs a corresponding upgrade note in docs/private-installer/ha-dr.md; 3) restore-drill CLI should remain idempotent and support --dry-run and --abort-window flags.
review_conversation: Initial review requested changes: add rollback & abort flow; make PDBs opt-in for dev profiles; expand integration tests. Author responded and pushed fixes, then requested re-review. Miguel and Priya approved after fixes. Ethan provided final Terraform naming cleanups. One CI re-run due to flaky network test; all checks green before merge.
notes: Runbooks-as-code added under ops/runbooks/ha-dr; these should be used for run drills and incident playbooks.
This PR is opt-in for older clusters; production profile will enable by default for new installs.
